_comment: MANUAL DATA — weekly synthesized alerts and the KEV→portfolio map on threat-intel.html. The KEV map is your systems' exposure (requires local knowledge); the raw KEV/CVE/KB feeds update automatically in data/auto/. badge tones: crit | warn | info | ok | mute | gold.
kicker: Weekly Synthesized Alerts · Week of 08 JUN 2026

alerts.title: CVE-2026-31822 — Web Framework RCE
alerts.what: Pre-auth remote code execution; added to CISA KEV 05 JUN. Active exploitation confirmed.
alerts.impact: LOGNET-04 web tier runs the affected framework. Compromise degrades supply requisitions for three supported brigades.
alerts.action: Patch by 12 JUN (KEV 7-day clock). WAF rule WR-2218 deployed as interim; verify in your segment, rescan, and update PM-2287.

alerts.title: VPN Concentrator Auth Bypass
alerts.what: Vendor out-of-band patch for an authentication bypass; PoC public, no confirmed exploitation in DoD space.
alerts.impact: Remote-access path for SUPPLY-NET and MEDLOG-01 administrators.
alerts.action: Apply vendor patch during the 14 JUN maintenance window; enforce phishing-resistant MFA on all admin VPN profiles by 20 JUN.

alerts.title: Credential Phishing — Logistics Theme
alerts.what: Spear-phish wave imitating transportation-request portals targeting Army logistics personnel; 14 attempts caught at the gateway this week.
alerts.impact: Harvested credentials enable initial access against SUPPLY-NET user accounts.
alerts.action: Forward suspicious mail to the watch desk; supervisors brief teams using the 2-minute awareness card; report any click within 1 hour.

alerts.title: OT Firmware End-of-Support
alerts.what: RANGE-OT controller firmware reaches end-of-support 30 SEP 2026; no further security patches.
alerts.impact: Unsupported firmware on the live-fire range instrumentation segment raises residual risk beyond current acceptance (DR-2026-022).
alerts.action: Engineering evaluates replacement candidates by 15 JUL; isolation controls re-validated this quarter.

kev_map.status: Exception — compensating isolation, AO acceptance on file
